verdict.rationale: Real-time voice conversation is a fair question for a consumer AI assistant like Kimi, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents voice input, voice output, or live spoken conversation. The items cover coding tools, the chat UI, agents, the API and community model impressions, and none of these mention voice.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can have a natural, real-time voice conversation with the assistant
